tools.description: Returns the reference of one endpoint: what it does, the key it needs, its parameters, the request and response fields and the error codes. version is "v1" (v1 is stable) or "v2" (v2 is beta); method is the HTTP method; path is written as in the reference, with or without the version prefix, e.g. /payments/link or /payments/{paymentID}. An endpoint that does not exist is DOC_SECTION_NOT_FOUND with the closest titles. version, method and path are required. Read-only.
